notes.title: PESTICIDE - FREE to play
notes.content:
Hello everyone

We are giving this announcement to Steam’s global community to explain in detail all the reasons behind the decision to make PESTICIDE a FREE-TO-PLAY game from now on.

Recently we've all been notified by UNITY corp. about their new / latest changes and plans in regards to payment models for all their partners who use UNITY engine for their game creations.
Many ( if not all ) of these changes are not something we wish to support and stand behind.

This of course updated our own relationship with them due to the fact that we used Unity engine to create PESTICIDE and planned to continue to use it in order to bring more updates in the future.
Now thanks to their policy changes all those plans for updates are abruptly stopped.

Some of you may already know that PESTICIDE is a project created by 3 people in total, but in reality the majority of work on the game was created by only two of us - myself and a programmer.

We started this game as a passion project, first as a simple prototype that highlights the core game loop and later on as a full game with 5 regions and 15 levels. events and simple story with huge emphasis on fluid dynamic combat system, adult humor and simplified stylized mayhem.

I am really happy and proud to say that my colleagues and I have achieved this goal and many more during our development time.


For their effort and their willingness to elope with me on this project I am truly and deeply grateful, of course this extends to everyone else who contributed to the finalization of the project in the background.


THANK YOU !

We have never pivoted PESTICIDE on the monetary gains, we never expected to get rich nor did we expect some insane financial return from the sales.  We were always just interested in making fun games but we sadly cannot continue to do that anymore in Unity.


For us, the UNITY engine is now the relic of the past unless Unity leadership decides to back down on new policies and return Unity to the former business model.


We hope players will now understand our position and where we stand in regards to these policies.
We would also like to thank each and every one of our supporters who purchased the game and hopefully had fun playing it. 
Of course for players who purchased the game nothing changes, game will remain on the store for as long as Steam allows it to be here.


PESTICIDE will switch to FREE TO PLAY in upcoming weeks due to Steam's policy regarding this procedure, feel free to tell your friends about it, we would be more then happy to see people enjoying the game and have fun.
Thank you for your understanding and your support.

Sincerely, 
Nuclear Dog team
N.R

notes.title: PESTICIDE - NEW AND IMPROVED
notes.content:
Howdy Exterminators !
MAJOR UPDATE is here ! ! !

Long time no-C ! Well, in our defence we've been awfully busy with the biggest overhaul of PESTICIDE yet !
Lets go over some of the biggest game changers we can list :

LEVELS - All 15 levels have been significantly expanded and redesigned to better fit the new game dynamic that we constructed.

ENEMIES - In general all enemies and their behaviours have been vastly improved.
New animations and states were added to the majority of cockroaches.
On top of all that we've then added a new enemy to the group and named him - HOOLIGANERO !
We have no doubt you'll have fun playing against him, but be careful he is not friendly at all.

CHALLENGE MODE  - For now challenge mode is removed from the game ( it will be back, at some point)

PUSSY KATTY - Pussy K is now your companion - shocking, we know....:)
After you find her and save her from her cage she will follow you wherever you go and try to help you as best as she can by providing boosters both practical and moral. She can even alert you if danger is near.

MACHINES - While exploring the world you will undoubtedly find new and interesting machines like dispensers, slot machines, skin switcher machines, power nodes,wack-a-beaver machines, simple locks etc.and all of them have their own unique function in the world but, be sure to always have enough Devil's coins for the machines, no coin - no service !

SKINS - New skins have been added for both Player and Katty characters. In total we've added 16 different and unique skins for player and 10 equally interesting and sexy skins for our lovely Katty so that she is always a sight for sore eyes.

PROJECTILES - projectile system has received a complete overhaul.
Projectiles will now leave a trace while you shoot, they are much more precise and much more devastating.

STORY - Each level loading screen will now explain a small fragment in the game's story but in a very organic and non-intrusive way which is of course the main reason behind the decision to add story and expand the experience in this further.

DEADLY FOG - Yes, as the name suggests this fog is very deadly but, fear not - GAS MASKS are always nearby and ready to fully assist you.

SLOW MOTION + DASH - Two new movement abilities have been added with this update.
Players can now slow down time at will or dash to a side in order to tip the balance of the skirmish in their favour. Think fast, you'll need it.




There are many many more tweaks, fixes and novelties but let's leave you guys to explore them on your own. Hope you'll enjoy this update and remember - cockroaches need no mercy from you so give them none !

Nuclear Dog Team / N.R.

notes.title: PESTICIDE - Update #3
notes.content:
[h1]Howdie Exterminators ![/h1]

#3update is here ! ːsteamhappyː

We'll try to now sit back and relax for a while so beside some minor tweaks here and there there will be no more updates to our core gameplay for a while.
So, lets go over everything that this update bring :


[h1]Gameplay [/h1]

Pussy Katty's cage is now equipped with dynamite on a timer.

This of course means that when player moves to a certain position he will automatically trigger the bomb timer ( HUD icon will appear as well ) informing him that in approximately X number of seconds the cage will blow up.

If the bomb timer ends and bomb explodes your run will instantly stop because you cannot progress to the next level if you didn't kill every roach and save every Pussy Katty..

Of course once you deactivate the timer by simply shooting at the cage, kicking the cage or throwing things on it you can take your time and explore ( don't forget you can do this from a distance as well ).

This change will retain enough pressure on the player while simultaneously allowing him to pace his game the way he wants and hunt for collectables / secrets but he needs to save Katty first.

[h1]Bug fixes :[/h1]

Bullet / projectile size is now properly adjusted so that bullets don't stick to surfaces from a funky angle ( shotgun was OK so we didn't tweak that at all ) .

Light values on certain levels needed some tweaks so we did just that ( less very dark areas, now only dark areas :))

Enemy units would get stuck in certain parts of certain maps due to navigation confusing them a bit. Now they should be just fine ( hopefully )

[h1]Adjustments :[/h1]

Toxic barrels, propane tanks now have a slightly smaller radius for damage so that they don't link up too much and unintentionally kill players.

Enemy positions - we basically rearranged units on every level so that they can more precisely cover empty distance from one Pussy Katty cage to another.

Automatico unit - new bright orange suit that is more visible in certain areas. This should more or less fix the problem where players couldn't spot them due to their kneeling position.

Pussy Katty cage - new upgrade to the Pussy cage - dynamite bundles with a time counter that surrounds the cage. Don't let it explode, it's not very healthy ːsteamsaltyː

Running sounds of all enemies have been properly adjusted and now they are noticeable and easier to pinpoint.

[h1]Music :[/h1]
New level theme added to the list.
[h1]Sounds :[/h1]
New sounds added to bomb counter.
[h1]Hints : [/h1]
New hints added to the list.

notes.title: PESTICIDE - Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Howdie Exterminators ![/h1]

In this update we focused more on some gameplay design tweaks, sounds library expansion and general bug fixes / small fixes.

update includes :

Time limits for MAIN MODE are now temporarily disabled to allow more exploration -
Playing MAIN MODE will allow players enough room to explore and hunt for collectables ( trophies, photos, details etc. ) without the time as a pressure element.

Best level time in MAIN MODE will now directly drive CHALLENGE MODE time limits -
Game will now record best play time for each level and adjust challenge time according to that stat. Each level playthrough will tailor your own challenge time so that you can always push your limits while retaining a strong sense of progression in terms of speed and accuracy / strategy.

bug fixes :

Pitch value on running sound adjusted to fit better with world sounds.
Running sound is now corrected to better illustrate what is happening on screen.
Pistol ammo collider size adjusted for more easier pickup
( this should fix all situations where you walked over ammo but didn't pick it up immediately ).

additional changes :
Hints - new hints added, old hints updated and fixed ( some grammar issues )
Sounds
[list]
[*]  new one liners added
[*]  new running sound added
[/list]
